As Toyota Motor (TM) Market Valuation Declined, Howard Hughes Medical Institute Has Raised by $8.89 Million Its Stake; As Brunswick (BC) Share Price Rose, Grandfield & Dodd Has Increased Its Stake by $726,825
April 30, 2018 - By Adrian Mccoy
Howard Hughes Medical Institute increased its stake in Toyota Motor Corp (TM) by 127.27% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Howard Hughes Medical Institute bought 70,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.22% with the market. The institutional investor held 125,000 shares of the auto manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $15.90M, up from 55,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Howard Hughes Medical Institute who had been investing in Toyota Motor Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $191.65 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.03% or $0.04 during the last trading session, reaching $131.05. About 153,216 shares traded. Toyota Motor Corporation (NYSE:TM) has risen 14.60% since April 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 3.05% the S&P500.
Grandfield & Dodd Llc increased its stake in Brunswick Corp (BC) by 7.81% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Grandfield & Dodd Llc bought 13,215 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.93% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 182,415 shares of the industrial machinery and components company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $10.07M, up from 169,200 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Grandfield & Dodd Llc who had been investing in Brunswick Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $5.23B market cap company. The stock increased 0.72% or $0.43 during the last trading session, reaching $59.9. About 606,075 shares traded. Brunswick Corporation (NYSE:BC) has declined 3.37% since April 30, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.92% the S&P500.
Among 9 analysts covering Toyota Motor Corporation ( NYSE:TM ), 2 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 6 Hold. Therefore 22% are positive. Toyota Motor Corporation had 20 analyst reports since August 19, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Wednesday, October 4 by Citigroup. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Tuesday, August 15 by Jefferies. The firm has “Neutral” rating by JP Morgan given on Wednesday, August 19. Citigroup downgraded Toyota Motor Corporation (NYSE:TM) on Thursday, August 25 to “Neutral” rating. The rating was upgraded by Macquarie Research to “Outperform” on Monday, February 20. The company was upgraded on Friday, February 17 by Macquarie Research. The stock of Toyota Motor Corporation (NYSE:TM) earned “Neutral” rating by Macquarie Research on Thursday, December 15. The firm earned “Neutral” rating on Wednesday, February 24 by Bank of America. The rating was maintained by Jefferies on Friday, November 10 with “Hold”. The rating was downgraded by Credit Suisse to “Neutral” on Friday, February 26.
Howard Hughes Medical Institute, which manages about $385.41M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Mcdonalds Corp (NYSE:MCD) by 15,000 shares to 25,000 shares, valued at $4.30M in 2017Q4, according to the filing.
Grandfield & Dodd Llc, which manages about $885.55M and $936.78M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2,753 shares to 29,202 shares, valued at $4.94 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Microsoft Corp (NASDAQ:MSFT) by 20,107 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 467,483 shares, and cut its stake in Dominion Energy Inc (NYSE:D).
Among 18 analysts covering Brunswick ( NYSE:BC ), 16 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 2 Hold. Therefore 89% are positive. Brunswick had 72 analyst reports since September 4, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The stock has “Overweight” rating by KeyBanc Capital Markets on Friday, March 2. The stock has “Buy” rating by B. Riley & Co on Friday, July 28. Stifel Nicolaus maintained it with “Buy” rating and $65.0 target in Wednesday, January 17 report. The stock of Brunswick Corporation (NYSE:BC) earned “Buy” rating by C.L. King on Monday, March 5. JP Morgan initiated Brunswick Corporation (NYSE:BC) on Wednesday, December 16 with “Overweight” rating. RBC Capital Markets maintained Brunswick Corporation (NYSE:BC) rating on Friday, January 27. RBC Capital Markets has “Outperform” rating and $65 target. The stock of Brunswick Corporation (NYSE:BC) earned “Buy” rating by BMO Capital Markets on Thursday, July 13. The stock has “Buy” rating by BMO Capital Markets on Friday, February 2. Citigroup maintained Brunswick Corporation (NYSE:BC) rating on Monday, November 13. Citigroup has “Buy” rating and $58 target. The stock of Brunswick Corporation (NYSE:BC) has “Outperform” rating given on Tuesday, January 31 by Imperial Capital.
